# es.pinterest.com

> Spanish Pinterest is a visual discovery and curation platform featuring official brand accounts, user-generated content, and curated collections across fashion, home decor, design, and lifestyle inspiration.

es.pinterest.com serves the Spanish-speaking Pinterest community with verified merchant accounts from major retailers like ZARA, Zara Home, and El Corte Inglés, alongside user boards and curated idea collections. The platform emphasizes visual inspiration through fashion trends, home decor, DIY crafts, drawings, and design resources.

## Key Topics

- Pinterest
- ZARA

## Official Brand Accounts

- [· ZARA · (zaraofficial)](https://es.pinterest.com/zaraofficial/): Official ZARA brand Pinterest account showcasing fashion collections
- [Zara Home (zarahome)](https://es.pinterest.com/zarahome/): Official Zara Home Pinterest account featuring home decor collections
- [El Corte Inglés (elcorteingles)](https://es.pinterest.com/elcorteingles/): Official El Corte Inglés department store Pinterest account
- [El País (elpaiscom)](https://es.pinterest.com/elpaiscom/): Official El País news organization Pinterest profile with journalism content

## Discovery & Exploration

- [Explore the best of Pinterest](https://es.pinterest.com/ideas/): Pinterest discovery hub for recipes, home ideas, and style inspiration
- [Imágenes De Pinterest](https://es.pinterest.com/ideas/im%C3%A1genes-de-pinterest/913705407250/): Curated gallery of Pinterest images and aesthetic wallpaper ideas
- [Dibujos De Pinterest](https://es.pinterest.com/ideas/dibujos-de-pinterest/926462015170/): Curated ideas collection for drawing and doodle inspiration
